A real Advanced bot turn repeatedly alternated purchase and open-series. With empty draw/discard piles it paid13cards and redrew the same13; exact card placement alternated between two states. Opportunity scoring repeatedly selected this zero-growth purchase.

In a deterministic dense fixture it consumed3.878s of the shared2s runtime context, leaving no live deadline for durable submission. fixes: Optional room difficulty atomically creates durable server-owned bot seats; credential restrictions and human-only benefits enforced.
Reuse fair beginner/standard/advanced policy observations through authoritative validated idempotent commands and existing dispatcher.
Expose real bot setup, public labels, immutable pending-room recovery and explicit human round choices with duplicate guards and preserved drafts.
Check bounded own-inventory Coup eligibility at each actor boundary and validate through the same authority.
Round bot votes wait for the human choice, preserving first-click version validity without retries or relaxed admission.
Derive missing legacy snapshot flags from the same committed checkpoint and tolerate only absent new flags in immutable historical journal projections.
Recreate only the decision scroll viewport on meaningful game/round/workspace changes, keeping the globally keyed form subtree, draft state and ordinary-resize identity stable.

Add server_pending from the persisted lifecycle planner; disable ordinary commands and show Preparing the next move until false, preserving immediate Coup admission. Enrich legacy authorized views and allow only absent new derived metadata in immutable receipt compatibility.

Filter online suggestions to purchases drawing strictly more cards than the physical payment count. This breaks the proven empty-deck acquisition cycle using only authorized candidate inputs, without changing authority legality, human choices, required responses, immediate Coup or frozen offline/evaluation policies. This is not a general game-termination proof.

Rank online candidates before expensive lifecycle validation. Preserve the exact v1 key fallback for ambiguous choices and eager validation of financial operations. Honour cancellation during menu construction and discard partial cancelled results. Original background-context APIs, offline policies and the two-second worker deadline stay unchanged.
